response.sql: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS scans_done, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_minute FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) AS all_operator_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(o.scans_done) AS average_scans_done, AVG(o.gb_per_minute) AS average_gb_per_minute, AVG(o.gb_per_minute - b.all_operator_gb_per_minute) AS average_excess_gb_per_minute FROM operator_stats AS o CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE o.gb_per_minute > b.all_operator_gb_per_minute;
